title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi reminisces with an old friend about movies. Encouraged by Mathi and Malar, Lakshmi asks Ragavan for permission to watch one but he rejects it.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vennila borrows money at a high interest rate to help Rajeshwari clear her debt. At the workshop, Kanmani is impressed by Anbu's knowledge of baby care and maternity needs.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel requests Muthuvel and Sakthivel to join the anniversary celebration. Meanwhile, Gomathi and Pandian are amazed by the grand wedding arrangements made by their family.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sathya suggests funding Meena's delivery while Chandra plans to care for her. Annamalai becomes the first customer for Meena and Muthu's Gulkand, which Rohini helps sell.
